Satellite BeoCube (Braunschweig Educational Orbital CubeSat)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status cancelled

Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education

Oneliner

Educational training and GNSS receiver and laser retro reflector.
Description

Educate university students and support research in fields like space situational awareness and orbit propagation.

BePod - Braunschweig Experimental Precise Orbit Determination – a software defined Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) receiver that can support multiple GNSS signals. 2. The secondary payload, a

Laser Ranging Experiment (LaREx) – consisting of Laser Retro Reflector scaled down to fit nanosatellite size - will be used to verify GNSS accuracy.
